findings.summary: The Go conformance test reads a fixed list of fixture folders (pipeline, agent-role, quality-gate, autonomy-policy, adapter), so the six new folders never run there. That is consistent with the Go exemptions still listed in conformance/parity/exemptions.json and is out of scope here. When Go support for these kinds is added, it should read every folder, as the Python test does.
